metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.2 · 1979 · Meatballs
metas.description: Another summer descends upon North Star summer camp, and care-free counselor Tripper leads the mediocre and mismanaged campers against their arch rivals at the very well run and expensive neighboring camp, Mohawk.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 3.9 · 1984 · Meatballs Part II
metas.description: Second in the series of Meatball movies. A group of kids attempt to save a summer camp that's a financial failure.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 3.6 · 1986 · Meatballs III: Summer Job
metas.description: The ghost of a dead porn star comes to Earth to help a nerd with his sex life.
